name: Codalogy
description_en:
Codalogy is a product in the AI coding category. Its directory profile covers Documentation Assitance, Code Linting, Context-Aware Code, Error Logs, AI Copilot, Security and Privacy Compliance, Multi Programming Languages, Code Completion.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $15.00. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.
